List counts are the constructed 60s currently on that source. Tournament lists live on event pages ([[List of SWCCG tournaments]], [[Championships]]); the count is event lists whose titles carry a year and Light or Dark. A list posted both to an event page and to a fan catalog can appear in both rows.

[[Fan sites]] indexes the independent websites. [[DeckTech tournament reports]] name pairings and finishes and sometimes a 60.

== How lists are arranged ==

* '''Tournament tables:''' Date, Format, Event, Finish, Player, Dark, Light. Event is the event page. Dark and Light are the constructed lists; pipe text is the Objective 0-side or starting site.
* '''General tables:''' Date, Format, Title, Side, Author. Title is the list.
